counterfactual_missing_items: No splenomegaly or organomegaly on CT chest/abdomen/pelvis
No marked leukocytosis or basophilia (WBC 11.5, basophils 2.7%)
No prior CML or chronic-phase features
decisive_items: Immunostaining: Positive for CD34, CD10, CD19; negative for CD20 and CD33
Bone marrow biopsy: Hypercellular marrow packed with immature cells
response.rationale: C1 is the most complete diagnosis: 60% marrow blasts with CD10/CD19 positivity and CD20/CD33 negativity establish B-cell ALL. R7 is the main Ph/BCR-ABL differential, but CML would require chronic-phase leukocytosis, basophilia, or splenomegaly; the acute blast phenotype favors ALL. R3 is a less-specific correlated version of C1. R4/R8/R5/R6 explain only incidental diabetes, hypertension, or VTE history and ignore the marrow/immunophenotype.

rejected.why: Superseded by C1; same ALL diagnosis but lacks the B-cell subtype supported by CD10/CD19.
Diabetes and sensory loss are incidental; does not explain cognitive changes, marrow blasts, or immunophenotype.
Factor V Leiden/VTE history is remote and unconfirmed by imaging; cannot explain acute leukemia findings.
Hyperglycemia and cognitive symptoms are nonspecific; cannot explain marrow blasts, CD10/CD19 positivity, or Ph+.
Elevated BP is nonspecific and does not explain marrow blasts or B-lymphoid markers.
